highlights: Deformation stack: bend, twist, taper and more on a whole Part, with a live preview you can reorder and apply (thanks foirgairwolf on Discord)
Slimmer Library and timeline: about a third less height, with the timeline as one thin row by default (thanks factoberplay on YouTube)
Small screens: below 1280 px the side palettes open as drop-downs instead of not opening at all
Membership moments: a quiet heart in the top bar and an occasional thank-you at a milestone; nothing in the app is ever paywalled
